name: Code files
description: Code and text files in the vault: listed in the sidebar and quick open, opened in a code editor with syntax highlighting, and the agent skill folders (.agents/skills, .claude/skills).

memory.note: The code editor and its language data load when the first code file opens; nothing runs in the background. Switching applies at once to the editor, the file watcher and rename; folders already shown in the sidebar re-list when you reopen them, quick open and the index follow the next time the workspace opens.
